settings.text: Best-in-class refurbishment
Multi-point quality inspection
Free 30-day returns
1-year warranty

settings.title: Done in-house
settings.text: Every device is inspected, repaired and graded by our own technicians in the GTA. No middlemen.

settings.title: Battery health you can trust
settings.text: Minimum 80% battery health on every phone. The exact number is listed before you buy.

settings.title: Clean slate
settings.text: Factory reset, full data wipe, and a deep clean and polish on every device we sell.

settings.title: Real people, real stores
settings.text: Talk to a real person by phone, chat, or at one of our stores when you need help.

settings.title: Better for the planet
settings.text: Buying refurbished keeps working tech in use and out of landfill.

settings.title: No red flags
settings.text: Every device is checked to be unlocked, not blacklisted, and not reported lost or stolen.

settings.title: Peace of mind
settings.text: Every purchase comes with a 1-year warranty, free 30-day returns, and support when you need it.

settings.title: Cameras
settings.text: Every camera is tested for focus, image capture and video, including front-facing video calls.

settings.title: GPS and positioning
settings.text: GPS, compass and location services are checked for an accurate fix.

settings.title: Touchscreen
settings.text: The full screen is tested for touch response, dead zones and ghost touches.

settings.title: Face ID and fingerprint
settings.text: Face ID, Touch ID and fingerprint sensors are tested to unlock correctly every time.

settings.title: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and cellular
settings.text: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, NFC and cellular signal are tested on live networks.

settings.title: IMEI and blacklist
settings.text: The IMEI is checked against carrier blacklists and lost or stolen reports. Every phone is unlocked.

settings.title: Liquid damage
settings.text: Internal liquid indicators are checked. Devices with water damage don't get sold.

settings.title: Flash and lights
settings.text: The flash and indicator lights are checked to work properly.

settings.title: Mics and speakers
settings.text: Every mic, earpiece and loudspeaker is tested for clear, distortion-free sound.

settings.title: Ports and charging
settings.text: The charging port, wired and wireless charging are tested.

settings.title: Battery health
settings.text: Battery capacity is measured. Phones below 80% get a new battery before they're listed.

settings.title: Touchscreen
settings.text: Full-screen touch response and pencil input are tested.

settings.title: Cameras
settings.text: Front and rear cameras are tested for focus and video.

settings.title: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth
settings.text: Wireless connections are tested, plus cellular on LTE models.

settings.title: Speakers and mics
settings.text: Every speaker and mic is tested for clear sound.

settings.title: Ports and charging
settings.text: Charging port and accessory connectors are tested.

settings.title: Battery health
settings.text: Battery capacity is measured and listed.

settings.title: Activation lock
settings.text: iCloud and Google account locks are removed and verified.

settings.title: Keyboard and trackpad
settings.text: Every key, the backlight and the trackpad are tested.

settings.title: Display
settings.text: The display is checked for dead pixels, backlight bleed and colour.

settings.title: Performance
settings.text: CPU, memory and storage are stress-tested.

settings.title: Webcam and mics
settings.text: The webcam and mics are tested for video calls.

settings.title: Ports
settings.text: Every USB, HDMI and audio port is tested.

settings.title: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth
settings.text: Wireless connections are tested for range and stability.

settings.title: Battery cycles
settings.text: Battery health and cycle count are measured.

settings.title: Firmware locks
settings.text: BIOS, MDM and Find My locks are removed and verified.

settings.title: Controllers
settings.text: Every button, stick and trigger is tested for drift and response.

settings.title: Video output
settings.text: HDMI output is tested at full resolution.

settings.title: Performance and cooling
settings.text: The console runs under load to check fans and temperatures.

settings.title: Ports and disc drive
settings.text: USB ports and the disc drive (if any) are tested.

settings.title: Online
settings.text: Wi-Fi, ethernet and online sign-in are tested.

settings.title: Account and ban check
settings.text: The console is reset and checked to be free of bans and old accounts.

settings.title: Sound quality
settings.text: Each earbud or speaker is tested for balance, clarity and distortion.

settings.title: Bluetooth pairing
settings.text: Pairing, range and connection stability are tested.

settings.title: Touch controls
settings.text: Touch and button controls are tested.

settings.title: Battery life
settings.text: Battery life of the earbuds and case is tested.

settings.title: Charging case
settings.text: Wired and wireless charging of the case is tested.
